verses.text: <pb/><t>Ifraimu tana kiwon iska,</t> <t>Tana ta bin iskar gabas dukan yini.</t> <t>Tana riɓaɓɓanya ƙarya da kamakarya.</t> <t>Tana ƙulla yarjejeniya da Assuriya,</t> <t>Tana kai mai a Masar.” <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji yana da magana game da mutanen Yahuza,</t> <t>Zai hukunta Isra'ila saboda hanyoyinta,</t> <t>Zai sāka mata gwargwadon ayyukanta.</t>
<t>A cikin mahaifa kakansu Yakubu ya kama diddigen ɗan'uwansa,</t> <t>Sa'ad da ya zama baligi ya yi kokawa da Allah.</t>
<t>Ya yi kokawa da mala'ika ya yi rinjaye.</t> <t>Ya yi kuka, ya roƙi albarka.</t> <t>Ya sadu da Allah a Betel,</t> <t>A can Allah ya yi magana da shi.</t>
<t>Sai ku koma wurin Allahnku,</t> <t>Ku yi alheri, ku yi adalci,</t> <t>Ku saurari Allahnku kullayaumin. <pb/></t>
<t>Ubangiji ya ce, “Ɗan kasuwa wanda yake da ma'aunin algus a hannunsa.</t> <t>Yana jin daɗin yin zalunci.</t>
<t>Mutanen Ifraimu sun ce, ‘Hakika, mun zama attajirai,</t> <t>Mun samar wa kanmu dukiya.</t> <t>A cikin harkokinmu ba za a sami wata mugunta ba.’</t>
<t>Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku tun daga ƙasar Masar,</t> <t>Zan kuma sa ku zauna cikin alfarwai,</t> <t>Kamar lokatan ƙayyadaddun idodi. <pb/></t>
<t>“Na yi magana da annabawa,</t> <t>Ni ne na ba da wahayi da yawa,</t> <t>Da misalai kuma ta wurin annabawa.</t>
<t>Idan akwai laifi a Gileyad,</t> <t>Hakika za su zama wofi.</t> <t>A Gilgal ana sadaka da bijimai,</t> <t>Bagadansu za su zama kamar tsibin duwatsu</t> <t>A gyaffan kunyoyin gona.” <pb/></t>
<t>Kakanmu Yakubu ya gudu zuwa ƙasar Aram,</t> <t>A can Isra'ila ya yi barantaka saboda mace,</t> <t>Saboda mace ya yi kiwon tumaki.</t>
<t>Ta wurin annabi Ubangiji ya fito da mutanen Isra'ila daga Masar,</t> <t>Ta wurin annabi kuma ya kiyaye su.</t>
<t>Mutanen Ifraimu sun yi muguwar tsokana mai ta da fushi,</t> <t>Domin haka Ubangiji zai ɗora musu hakkin jini a kansu,</t> <t>Zai saka musu cin mutuncin da suka yi.</t>
